name: 色域分析
description: 检测 out-of-gamut or unnaturally distributed colors. AI images often produce colors that exceed the natural camera gamut with excessive vibrancy.
algorithm: Color Gamut Range and Saturation Distribution Analysis
mechanism: 测量 extreme, near-clipping, and high-饱和度-high-亮度 pixel ratios 以识别 AI生成的 color 模式.
parameters: Sampling: 50000 pixels, Metrics: extreme ratio, clip ratio, vibrant ratio
useCase: Identifying unnaturally vibrant colors in AI生成的 content

references.title: Finlayson, G.D. et al. (2005). On the Removal of Shadows from Images. IEEE TPAMI.
Larson, G.W. et al. (1998). A Visibility Matching Tone Reproduction. IEEE CG&A.
Sharma, G. (2003). Digital Color Imaging Handbook. CRC Press.

strengths:
• 识别 physically impossible color combinations
• Camera-independent 分析 approach
• Reveals AI-specific 色彩空间 usage 模式
• Fast 分析 of color 分布
• Strong indicator when out-of-gamut colors detected
limitations:
• Camera color profiles vary widely 之间 manufacturers
• Post-processing and color grading change gamut coverage
• Wide-gamut displays and HDR expand valid 色彩空间
• ICC profile-aware editors produce legitimate wide-gamut
• Some AI models now generate 内的 natural gamut
